The real estate agent is selling two homes right now: one that was owned by a Venezuelan family, and one that was owned by a Sri Lankan family. The agents needs to have both houses cleaned, but the Sri Lankan family's house needs more cleaning because it smells of food, while the Venezuelan family home will be a breeze to sell. Which home is hard to sell because it smells?
A. The Venezuelan family's home
B. The Sri Lankan family's home
C. Undetermined
